comment: State-transition cases over the configuration set. anchors map a label to its class, generation and opaque key material; two labels sharing a key collide. initial is the durable set state. Each event carries the artifact's signer label (or unknown), whether its signature verifies, and for a binding the verdict its own contract returns; the checker recomputes the composition verdict and the resulting state view. No case carries bytes: the artifacts' own contracts own byte-level verification.

cases.name: consistent_set_starts_with_actuation
cases.note: A provisioning document and a binding at the same inventory generation, both accepted. Hardened startup starts, and actuation is licensed.

cases.name: hardware_without_binding_refuses_hardened_startup
cases.note: Actuating hardware declared and no binding accepted. Hardened posture refuses; development starts degraded with no protection claim.

cases.name: no_hardware_needs_no_binding
cases.note: A provisioning document declaring no actuating hardware starts under hardened posture without a binding. There is nothing to actuate.

cases.name: anchor_collision_refuses_every_posture
cases.note: The provisioning and commissioning anchors hold the same key material. The separation does not exist and no document can repair it.

cases.name: provisioning_signed_by_commissioning_key_is_wrong_authority
cases.note: A perfectly signed provisioning document whose signer is the commissioning anchor. Selection is anchor-wide, the signature verifies against the key the document names, and only then is authority decided.

cases.name: provisioning_signed_by_unknown_key
cases.note: signing_key matches no configured anchor. No authority verdict is issued and no signature is attempted.

cases.name: provisioning_naming_the_right_key_with_a_bad_signature
cases.note: The document names the provisioning anchor and the signature does not verify. bad_signature, decided before any authority verdict; naming a key is not holding it.

cases.name: provisioning_signed_by_previous_generation_is_superseded
cases.note: The demoted provisioning key verifies and is then refused as superseded_signer: a rotated key of our own, not a stranger.

cases.name: content_is_decided_after_authority
cases.note: A validly signed, correctly authored provisioning document carrying a field of another authority. foreign_field is reached only because signature and authority passed first.

cases.name: provisioning_freshness_by_inventory_generation
cases.note: A lower generation is a replay; an equal generation with different content is a producer violation; an equal generation with identical content is an idempotent no-op.

cases.name: inventory_advance_withdraws_actuation_until_recommissioned
cases.note: The provisioning inventory advances to 8. The accepted binding now names 7: actuation is withdrawn and the set reports a mismatch while observation continues. A binding at 8 restores it. Hardened startup in between refuses.

cases.name: binding_ahead_is_held_pending_then_applied
cases.note: Commissioning finishes before provisioning catches up. The binding at 8 is retained pending, not applied; when the provisioning document reaches 8 the pending binding is applied in the same step.

cases.name: binding_behind_the_inventory_is_not_applied
cases.note: A binding for generation 7 arriving after the inventory reached 8 describes hardware the device no longer declares.

cases.name: binding_freshness_precedes_composition
cases.note: A binding whose binding_seq does not exceed the accepted one is stale under its own contract before composition is reached, whatever generation it names.

cases.name: binding_contract_refusal_is_reported_as_itself
cases.note: A binding refused by its own contract — here a proof contradiction — is reported with that verdict and never reaches composition.

cases.name: binding_authority_verdicts
cases.note: A binding signed by the provisioning key is wrong_authority; one signed by the previous commissioning generation is superseded_signer; one naming an unknown key is unknown_signer.

cases.name: accepted_artifacts_survive_rotation
cases.note: The set was accepted under keys that are now the previous generation. Nothing is re-verified: startup starts with actuation. Only a new artifact under the demoted key is refused.

cases.name: legacy_document_then_latch
cases.note: An unlatched device loads a legacy document, held at generation 1 as legacy-derived. The first v2 document supersedes it whatever generation it names — a producer legitimately starts at 1 and the derivation was never an allocation — and latches. A legacy document afterwards is refused, and the latch survives a restart.

cases.name: legacy_document_must_still_verify
cases.note: Legacy handling is a migration, not a bypass. A legacy document carries no signing_key, so it is verified against the current provisioning anchor alone: signed by another key, by the previous provisioning key, or with a bad signature, every failure is bad_signature, and wrong_authority is unreachable for it.

cases.name: nothing_runs_without_a_provisioning_document
cases.note: An empty set refuses to start in every posture.

cases.name: entitlement_is_retained_and_never_touches_actuation
cases.note: A verified entitlement applies; a refused one leaves the previous in force; and actuation is licensed by the inventory invariant alone, with or without entitlement.
